QuestInfo.name: [Henesys Ruins] Forest in Time
QuestInfo.0: You put together what the people of the Henesys Ruins told you. It's certain now that the Cygnus Knights attacked Maple World. So what happened to Ereve?
QuestInfo.1: You put together what the people of the Henesys Ruins told you. It's certain now that the Cygnus Knights attacked Maple World. So what happened to Ereve? Go there and find out.
QuestInfo.2: Ereve used to be beautiful, but darkness has now encroached on it. Just like in Henesys, the monsters have changed. Anne has gone scouting there...

1.0: ...Who are you? You don't look like a Cygnus Knight. ...Have we met? Maybe in Ellinia?
